evidence: Requires the second argument to equal 0x10. It reads a player pointer at input+0xce0, passes that pointer to f_700183b3c0 with an output slot, and continues only when the helper returns true. It reads a 32-bit value at returned_object+0x70 and sign-extends its low 9 bits before calling the accepted place_player_on_waivers helper with the resolved player pointer and fixed arguments 2,2. Other paths return 1; the successful path returns 2. decompiled/main/main_0088.c:31627-31661.

The body obtains a two-part value through f_7001812190, applies upper-bound checks, then calls f_70018260f0 with the derived value. If that predicate is true, it reads accepted attribute-context status selector 0x27; when that status is nonzero it calls f_70007565a0(0,0), then returns zero. The called helper iterates fixed attribute indices and invokes accepted populate_record_output_from_attributes (f_70007567f0). Its precise caller/domain role is not established. decompiled/main/main_0058.c:17771-17806; helper decompiled/main/main_0056.c:9663-9815.

Returns 2 immediately when the input byte at +8 is nonzero. Otherwise it reads a pointer from global slot 0x7003abf000+0xa98; a null pointer or zero byte at either pointer+0x168 or +0x169 returns 0. When both bytes are nonzero it calls f_7000a4a1f0(pointer,4) and returns 1 without using that helper result. decompiled/main/main_0066.c:11946-11970.

Loads the pointer from global slot 0x7003abf000+0xc00 and continues only when it is nonnull and its 32-bit value at +4 equals 3. It obtains an entry pointer through f_7000b70898; when that helper succeeds it invokes accepted process_entries_with_callback (f_7000b733b0) on the returned pointer. The function always returns zero. decompiled/main/main_0088.c:20435-20460.

Calls f_70000bbd60 with selector 0x3d as an availability predicate. If it returns false, the function returns zero. If true, it calls accepted sum_matching_record_float_values_clamped with selector 0x3d, takes the returned scalar float from SIMD register 0, and returns the value with the observed 0x1_00000000 type marker. decompiled/main/main_0030.c:12438-12456.
